Access statement for Blaco Hill Farm Cottages

Our 7 self catering cottages have been converted from disused farm buildings, on a working arable farm. The cottages are set around a shared courtyard and carpark. We have tried to provide as much information as possible in this statement, if you have any queries please do call.

We look forwarding to welcoming you.

We have a no smoking policy in all our cottages

Pre-arrival

  • We are 4* rated with Visit Britain
  • We are listed on booking.com & groupaccommodation.com
  • Bookings/enquiries can be made via email or phone.
  • The nearest bus stop is at the bottom of the farm drive.
  • The nearest train station is 5 miles away in Retford.
  • We have wireless internet access

Arrival & car parking facilities

  • A large car park is provided for use by all cottages, there is space for 4 vehicles to park under cover on a first come first use basis.
  • Distance from each property to the car park varies.
  • Car park and path surface is small pea gravel over tarmac or concrete base.
